comments.text: What makes Zimbabwe especially fascinating is the relationship between people and wildlife. 🐘 Living near enormous elephant populations can be inspiring, but it also means protecting crops, water sources and communities while preserving the animals themselves. Add places like Great Zimbabwe and Mosi-oa-Tunya, and the country becomes far more than a safari destination: it is a story of history, culture, conservation and coexistence.
